mechanism_gain.name: critical Doob-Hardy adapted additive saturator
mechanism_gain.statement: On one exact Fourier shell, choose the progressive additive input Y_s=M_s=exp(W_s-3s/2). Then the exact solution is Z_s=M_s(W_s-s), E M_s^3=1, and for scaled horizons L_n=lambda_n T there are thresholds R_n with liminf R_n^3 m_n^sc/r_n^3 >= 8/9. Consequently every alpha<2/3 again fails by an explicit additive source-valid witness, while at alpha=2/3 any finite endpoint norm constant must be at least 2^(5/3)/9 under the report normalization.
mechanism_gain.scope: explicit progressive additive one-shell inputs on the exact frozen torus pair; this is not a proof of the positive full L^3 -> Z_{3,2/3} endpoint
